selection: All remaining unused sequence indices from source game 4 (archive inventory only), excluding prior gallery and first expansion clips. Every tenth native frame. Registered before these image/label downloads; no content curation.
clock: Sparse source image numbers preserved. These are not consecutive 25 FPS observations and must not be passed through the contiguous sample-video adapter.
conditions: SoccerNet research-only public ungated training archive; no raw redistribution or cloud image upload. No new NDA accepted.
limits: More scenes from the same previously exposed source games, not more independent matches. Prior unknown exposure cannot be ruled out. Data preparation alone is not an algorithm accuracy improvement.
